title: Chilombo v Hamaleke (Appeal 2 of 2016) [2018] ZMCC 1 (18 January 2018)
issue_tags: mandatory signature requirement for election petitions; validity of petition; substitution of petitioner (ss103–104); jurisdictional effect of procedural defects; procedural fairness in election petitions; security for costs (s102) and Tribunal Rules compliance.
outcome_detail: An election petition unsigned by the named petitioner is invalid and cannot be cured by subsequent substitution; appeal allowed
